Subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence for upcoming EDI onboarding

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the call this morning. As we scope PayBridge's EDI onboarding (850/810) into our AP flow, procurement has a couple of non-negotiable requirements we need Redwood to confirm before we proceed with the PO issuance:

- PO number must be present on every invoice in the PO-REF / reference field (our ERP requires exact match on PO-REF).
- We will be sending multiple POs that may be consolidated onto a single invoice header — is Redwood able to accept more than one PO number on an invoice (comma-separated) and still map to individual PO lines?
- Net terms default for us is net45, but finance is willing to consider net30 for an early-pay discount. Please confirm the standard net terms Redwood supports and whether you can process biweekly invoice cycles (we prefer a Monday/Thursday settlement window).

Also — can you send the expected EDI field mapping we need to provide to our EDI provider so they can prepare their X12 810 generation? We need that to finalize firewall/format testing.

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement is aiming to issue a blanket PO next week if the mapping and net terms align.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
PayBridge

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front and then a couple of notes:

- PO on invoice: yes, we require a PO reference field mapping to your PO-REF (we can accept the exact string your ERP provides).
- Multiple POs on a single invoice: we can accept multiple PO numbers as long as they are provided in the designated PO-REF field; during ingestion we will attempt to map line items back to PO numbers, but to guarantee automated matching we recommend also including a small CSV-style PO->line mapping in the invoice comment field (we'll provide the template).
- Net terms: our standard hosted-account terms are net45. We can pilot a net30 early-pay discount; details below.
- Invoice cadence: biweekly Monday/Thursday settlement windows are fine — we just need the first effective date and any cutover timing.

I'm attaching our PO field mapping template (PB_PO_Field_Mapping_Template.xlsx) and a short SOW that covers EDI test windows. Vanessa and Ben are copied to confirm commercial details and finalize the discount cadence.

Next step: if PayBridge is comfortable with the mapping file, please loop in your EDI vendor and we'll schedule a test window next week.

Thanks,

Hi Lena — looping back with proposed language and next steps after an internal review. Thanks for the patience.

1) PO & multiple PO handling
We will accept the PO number(s) in your PO-REF field as the canonical reference. You may include multiple PO numbers separated by commas; to ensure reliable automated mapping, please include an optional two-column CSV line (PO_NUMBER,LINE_ID) in the invoice comments for any consolidated invoice. Our ingestion team will attempt to auto-map line items to PO numbers and will fall back to manual review if ambiguity remains.

2) Invoice cadence
We can support a biweekly settlement window on Mondays and Thursdays. Let's make the first effective processing day Monday, 2027-10-03 to align with your next AP run — please confirm.

3) Net terms & early-pay pilot
Standard term: net45.
Pilot offer: for the first 3 months after go-live, PayBridge can elect early-pay net30 with a 1.5% discount on qualifying invoices (qualifying invoices defined as: single-invoice total <= $250,000; invoice must contain valid PO-REF mapping). After the pilot, terms revert to net45 unless we mutually agree to a permanent amendment.

4) Next steps and attachments
- Attached: PB_PO_Field_Mapping_Template.xlsx (the EDI/CSV mapping template) and Redwood-PO-Integration-SOW.pdf (test windows and cutover checklist).
- Please share a contact from your EDI provider so we can schedule a 2-hour testing slot the week of 2027-10-03.
- I'll also open a HubSpot deal note (link below) and a short DocuSign for the pilot amendment once you confirm.
